nfr_1_1_data_sovereignty.meta_api_transport_policy: Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API with UAE Local Storage enabled for data-at-rest residency following Meta on-premises deprecation on 23 Oct 2025

fr_3_3_webhook_sla.pattern: Decoupled ingress (FastAPI) pushes raw payload to Redis (Celery) and returns HTTP 200 immediate queue acknowledgment

fr_4_1_cryptographic_data_segregation.class_a_threat_indicators: Persisted indefinitely in PostgreSQL (URLs, spoofed domains, scammer phone numbers, bank accounts, crypto wallets)
fr_4_1_cryptographic_data_segregation.class_b_citizen_identifiers: Strictly pseudonymized via keyed HMAC-SHA256 with 32-byte salt; zero persistence to database or logs
fr_4_1_cryptographic_data_segregation.ephemeral_transit_lifecycle: Raw citizen recipient phone exists in Redis broker list with a 60-second TTL strictly for outbound WhatsApp reply delivery, and is purged from RAM immediately post-dispatch

policy_doctrine.name: Zero Guess & No Mockup
rules: Production-ready code only (zero mockups, zero dummy data, zero pass blocks, zero TODO comments)
Every module syntactically complete and fully typed (Python 3.11+ / 3.12+)
Dual-Ledger system: SYSTEM_STATE.md and DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md maintained continuously

architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.issue: Ephemeral transit paradox: Celery worker requires raw citizen phone number to dispatch WhatsApp replies, but FR-4.1 mandates zero citizen PII persistence.
architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.resolution: Citizen phone number is queued with message broker expiration (expires=60s) strictly for outbound response routing. Worker explicitly purges recipient_phone from RAM scope (del recipient_phone) immediately post-dispatch before any DB write.

architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.issue: IDN Homograph detector in engine/homograph.py naively flagged all non-TLD labels starting with xn-- as Punycode homograph attacks, causing legitimate Arabic government portals under the .امارات ccTLD (e.g. بلدية-دبي.امارات -> xn----ymcbabb9a5b3a1a) to be flagged as Red High Risk.
architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.resolution: If TLD is .امارات (xn--mgbaam7a8h), non-TLD labels are decoded via idna.decode() and validated against the Arabic Unicode regex range ([\u0600-\u06FF\u0750-\u077F\u08A0-\u08FF0-9\-]). Authentic Arabic labels pass safely.

architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.issue: Flat Levenshtein edit distance (d <= 2) triggered false positive spoofing alerts on benign short domains (e.g. dew.ae vs dewa, ata.ae vs rta).
architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.resolution: Enforced length-normalized edit distance: (d / max_len) <= 0.25 restricted to domains with max_len >= 5.

architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.issue: Docker internal: true bridge network strips default gateway (0.0.0.0/0). Attaching api solely to internal: true prevented it from transmitting outbound SYN-ACK responses back to external Meta edge clients.
architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.resolution: Tri-network topology: hares_ingress (standard bridge for api port 8000), hares_internal (internal: true bridge isolating db and redis), and hares_egress (bridge granting worker HTTPS outbound access strictly to Meta endpoints).

architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.issue: Celery result_expires=60 only purges result backend metadata (celery-task-meta-*), leaving raw payloads in Redis broker queues indefinitely if workers lag.
architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.resolution: Replaced .delay() with .apply_async(args=[raw_payload], queue='high_priority_triage', expires=settings.REDIS_EPHEMERAL_PAYLOAD_TTL_SECONDS) to enforce broker-level message TTL.

architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.issue: Multi-stage Dockerfile executed pip install . in builder stage without copying src/ or README.md, crashing wheel compilation.
architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.resolution: Added COPY pyproject.toml README.md* ./ and COPY src/ ./src/ before pip install --no-cache-dir . in builder stage.

architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.issue: Starlette 1.7.0 on host environment deprecated and removed on_startup argument from Router.__init__, conflicting with FastAPI 0.116.1.
architectural_contradictions_and_remedia.resolution: Pinned starlette>=0.40.0,<0.48.0 in pyproject.toml and installed release 0.47.3.

community_checkpoints.finding: Trained on clean uncompressed speech; accuracy degrades catastrophically on 16kbps WhatsApp Opus audio due to lossy codec compression. Reclassified as CI/smoke-test only.

asvspoof_2021_calibration_trap.finding: ASVspoof 2021 DF is >100GB with almost entirely European/English phonetics. Non-parametric conformal prediction calibrated on ASVspoof breaks exchangeability for Gulf Arabic. Calibration must use Curated UAE Regional Opus Suite.

unified_whisper_dual_head_synergy.architecture: Whisper encoder embeddings simultaneously feed the ASR text decoder and an AASIST spoof classification head in a single forward pass, eliminating redundant WavLM passes and saving ~3.5 GB VRAM and ~180ms latency.
